entities.name: Albertus Soegijapranata
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albertus Soegijapranata, better known by his birth name Soegija, was a Jesuit priest who became the Apostolic Vicar of Semarang and later its archbishop. He was the first native Indonesian bishop and known for his pro-nationalistic stance, often expressed as "100% Catholic 100% Indonesian".
